integration_notes: Add server_kind 'seo' to mcp_manager/client.py SERVERS (server_file targets/seo/mcp_server.py, env_var SEO_URL, default_url http://localhost:8109) and to its TOOL_SPECS from tool_specs below; mirror the same entry in orchestrator/tools.py TOOL_SPECS + _BASE_URLS.
Path params used by tool paths: page_id, keyword_id — orchestrator/tools.py _PATH_PARAMS must learn both names for the direct fallback (mcp_manager's direct path fills any {placeholder} generically).

Job posting: translate jobs.json templates into engine Family entries (key/title/brief/budget/criteria) with department 'seo'; the worker executor dispatches on family key exactly like the QA families, calling only the tools in each template's tools_expected.

Reviewer: checks.py exposes CHECKS[family_key](call, criteria) returning one finding per acceptance criterion — wire it into the review step for seo jobs (note: unlike QA's single-criterion shape, SEO checks take the family's whole criteria list).

Surface discipline: the write tools save RECORDS (audit reports, briefs, keyword targets, link plans). There is deliberately no publish/edit-live-page tool — applying a plan or brief is a human decision outside this workplace.
mcp_server.py is the generated-style stand-in for `synapse build --local --auto`, identical in construction to QADesk's (the pattern this repo actually runs). See synapse_status.

reset.behaviour: Deletes seo.db and reseeds the exact seeded dataset (10 pages, 8 keywords, 12 internal links, no reports/briefs/plans). Same semantics as QADesk's reset.
reset.endpoint: POST /admin/reset (internal — NOT exposed as a tool)

planted_answers.brief_keyword: best trail running shoes for monsoon (4 seeded competitor angles)

service.health: GET /health (internal — NOT exposed as a tool)

synapse_status.flow_attempted: Not attempted for this department in this build. synapse_status.mcp_step: PENDING — run `synapse build --local --auto` in targets/seo/ when the repo-wide Synapse generation step lands, and drop the output in as synapse_auto_server.py beside mcp_server.py. The direct-mode tool layer below is complete and verified, so integration does not block on this.

tools.description: List the site's pages (url, title, meta description, H1, word count, load time, page type, traffic, inbound link count), optionally filtered by page_type.
tools.name: read_list_pages

tools.description: Deterministic on-page audit of one page: raw fields plus issues derived from them (missing title/meta/H1, thin content, slow template).
tools.name: read_get_page_audit

tools.description: List tracked keywords: term, volume, difficulty, current rank, intent, target page, seeded competitor angles.
tools.name: read_list_keywords

tools.description: Fetch one keyword with its competitor angles, target page and every content brief saved for it.
tools.name: read_get_keyword

tools.description: List the site's existing internal links (from/to pages and anchor text).
tools.name: read_list_links

tools.description: List saved audit reports with their per-page findings.
tools.name: read_list_audit_reports

tools.description: List saved internal-link plans with their planned links.
tools.name: read_list_link_plans

tools.description: Save an audit report (scope + per-page issue lists) as a record. No page is modified. Confirm-gated.
tools.name: write_save_audit_report

tools.description: Save a content brief for a keyword (title, intent, outline, competitor angles used, optional target page). A draft — nothing is published. Confirm-gated.
tools.name: write_save_content_brief

tools.description: Point a keyword at a target page (or clear its target). A planning record only. Confirm-gated.
tools.name: write_update_keyword_target

tools.description: Save an internal-link fix plan (planned links between existing pages). The site's actual link graph does not change. Confirm-gated.
tools.name: write_save_link_plan

workplace: SEODash — one seeded site's SEO console (pages, keywords, internal links, briefs)
